systems.owner: Tanzania Police Force, Statistics Unit (Kitengo cha Takwimu)
systems.tiers: working in 20 main stations of the Dar es Salaam zone and the offices of the Regional Crime Officers (RCOs), as of the report of January 2021; to be extended later to all police stations

note: The one system named is the Statistics Unit's electronic system for receiving crime information from the regions and preparing quarterly, half-yearly and annual reports: a statistics-class system by the report's own description, so no fact. The passage does not say whether a station enters each report in it.
